text:
ed: Quick thread to align on the marketplace onboarding for the next sprint. We need: offerId/planId mapping for Azure, cloud-specific offerIds for AWS/GCP, hero + thumbnail assets, and a short EULA snippet. Who's taking what?

kim: I can own the CSV mapping (offerId/planId per cloud). Question: do we keep one paid SKU across clouds or separate offers per cloud for region pricing?

jules: Separate offers per cloud please  easier for regional pricing and private offers. We'll keep a single trial SKU.

tara: I'll grab assets. AWS hero must be 3:2 <=1MB, GCP banner 16:9 (<=750KB), Azure thumbnail 1:1 (<=500KB). Ill upload compressed versions with alt text.

legal: Draft EULA snippet: 14-day trial, data deletion on request (removed within 30 days), and a mention that private offers may use customer-managed KMS. Drop the draft link where I can edit.

ed: Sounds good. Kim, put the CSV in the Drive and include an "exclude" column for internal-only SKUs (eg RED-BETA). jules, can you draft the 3 feature bullets for the listing blurb? Keep each bullet short.

kim: Uploading mapping now to Drive: https://drive.redwood.example/marketplace/1777/mapping.csv. Columns: sku,cloud,offerId,planId,visibility,exclude. Marked RED-BETA as exclude.

jules: Drafted bullets in product doc: low-latency hosted inference; predictable reserved capacity; developer-friendly API & SDKs. Pasted to product/marketplace/blurb-1777.md.

tara: Assets uploaded: https://drive.redwood.example/marketplace/1777/assets (includes alt text and variants). design-bot ran size checks and all pass.

design-bot: image-check: AWS hero 3:2 980KB, GCP 16:9 640KB, Azure 1:1 420KB. Badge for "accelerated" plan included (64x64 PNG).

kim: Note on Azure: planId is required per plan. CSV includes offerId + planId pairs. Example line: `RED-PRO,azure,off-az-001,plan-az-pro,public,false`.

jules: CTA recommendation: "Start free 14 days" as primary. Secondary: "Request demo".

legal: Reviewing EULA draft now: please add privacy FAQ link in the listing copy (product/privacy/marketplace-faq.md). Also prefer the phrase "Customer-managed KMS (BYOK)" rather than BYOK alone.

ed: Good catch. Use "Customer-managed KMS (BYOK)" in both listing and private offer details.

publish-bot: staging-publish: bundle-610 queued. Waiting on final manifest reference file `manifest-1777.csv` and assets.

kim: Pushed `manifest-1777.csv` to Drive and updated the mapping with cloud-specific offerId naming pattern: `RED-PRO-{cloud}-{region}`.

tara: Confirmed alt text added. Also included a short line for accessibility in the listing: "Alt text available in assets folder".

jules: Final blurb + bullets updated with privacy FAQ link and KMS sentence. Dropped in product doc and tagged legal.

legal: One small edit: change "removed within 30 days" to "removed within 30 calendar days". Otherwise OK.

ed: Minor change, noted. Kim/tara/jules/legal  can we run a 20-min preflight tomorrow 9:30am PT before we hit submit? Want one person to sign off on manifest, assets, and EULA.

kim: I'll be there to sign off on manifest.

tara: I'll confirm assets at 9:15 and join.

jules: I'll join for copy signoff.

publish-bot: staging-publish: bundle-610 now running validations against `manifest-1777.csv`. Results: manifest OK, assets referenced found. Waiting final EULA link to attach.

legal: EULA edit done and linked: https://docs.redwood.example/legal/eula-marketplace-1777.md. Please reference this in the manifest notes.

ed: Excellent. Action recap: kim final map (done), tara assets (done), jules blurb (done), legal EULA (done). Preflight tomorrow 9:30am PT. If no blockers we submit. Thanks all :tada:
